# Tollan

> Configuration management library for Python with validation, multi-source loading, caching, and astronomy-specific type support. Built on Pydantic v2 with a four-tier configuration architecture for flexible runtime configuration management.

Tollan is a Python library designed for astronomy projects that require sophisticated configuration management. It provides a flexible multi-source configuration system with precedence control, conditional loading, validation, caching, and built-in support for astronomy types (Time, Quantity, SkyCoord). The library uses a four-tier architecture (default, user sources, info, override) that allows precise control over configuration precedence while maintaining immutability where needed.

## Core API

- [Config Module](src/tollan/config/__init__.py): Main configuration exports including RuntimeContext, RuntimeConfig, and ConfigHandler
- [Runtime Context](src/tollan/config/runtime_context.py): RuntimeContext class for managing configuration lifecycle with four-tier architecture
- [Config Handler](src/tollan/config/handler.py): ConfigHandler base class for specialized configuration management
- [Runtime Info](src/tollan/config/runtime_info.py): RuntimeInfo dataclass for runtime metadata

## Configuration Sources

- [Sources Module](src/tollan/config/sources/__init__.py): ConfigSourceList and resolve_config_sources for multi-source configuration loading
- [Base Source](src/tollan/config/sources/base.py): Base configuration source interface and enable_if conditional loading
- [YAML Source](src/tollan/config/sources/yaml.py): YAML file configuration source with safe loading
- [Dict Source](src/tollan/config/sources/dict_.py): Dictionary-based configuration source
- [EnvFile Source](src/tollan/config/sources/envfile.py): Environment file (.env) configuration source
- [List Source](src/tollan/config/sources/list_.py): Nested configuration source lists

## Custom Types

- [Types Module](src/tollan/config/types/__init__.py): Astronomy-specific Pydantic types and validators
- [Quantity Types](src/tollan/config/types/quantity.py): Astropy Quantity fields with unit validation (length, angle, etc.)
- [Time Types](src/tollan/config/types/time.py): Astropy Time field with format support
- [SkyCoord Types](src/tollan/config/types/skycoord.py): Astropy SkyCoord field for celestial coordinates
- [Path Types](src/tollan/config/types/path.py): Enhanced path validation with existence checking

## Utilities

- [CLI Utilities](src/tollan/utils/cli.py): Command-line argument parsing with nested dict support
- [Dict Utilities](src/tollan/utils/dict.py): Recursive update and dictionary manipulation
- [YAML Utilities](src/tollan/utils/yaml.py): Custom YAML loading with safe defaults
- [FileLoc Utility](src/tollan/utils/fileloc.py): File location tracking with source information

## Testing

- [Config Tests](tests/config/): Comprehensive test suite for configuration system
- [Source Tests](tests/config/sources/test_sources_comprehensive.py): ConfigSourceList tests including caching, conditional loading, and merging
- [Runtime Context Tests](tests/config/test_runtime_context_comprehensive.py): RuntimeContext tests including tier manipulation, CLI creation, and context management
- [Handler Tests](tests/config/test_config_handler_comprehensive.py): ConfigHandler tests including auto-registration and cache invalidation
- [Type Tests](tests/config/types/test_astronomy_types.py): Custom astronomy type field tests
